answer_1.quote: the remarkable success of natural language generation (NLG) by pre-trained language models (PLMs) has given a boost to practical applications, making advertising a huge industrial use case for natural language processing (NLP).

answer_3.quote: We employed ... zero-/few-shot setting for LLMs, as well as human evaluators.

answer_4.quote: We enlisted three human evaluators who are not involved in AdOps to evaluate all tasks except AD PERFORMANCE ESTIMATION.
answer_4.guideline: Based on expert feedback, unacceptable ad phenomena include 'collapsing symbols,' 'unnatural repetition,' 'incomprehensible meaning', and 'underspecified/vague'.
